about: Moves between Germany and Poland, 1974-2024, from Germany's migration statistics (Statistisches Bundesamt, Wanderungsstatistik) as tabulated by the Federal Institute for Population Research (BiB), in thousands to one decimal (so rounded to 100). Zuzuege = arrivals in Germany from Poland ('immigration' here), Fortzuege = departures from Germany to Poland ('emigration'). Bis 1990 West Germany only. Results from 2016 are only partly comparable with earlier years. https://www.bib.bund.de/DE/Fakten/Fakt/M13-Zuzuege-Fortzuege-Deutschland-Polen-ab-1974.html
